title: U.S. House · Illinois's 5th District
area: Chicago's North Side lakefront and northern Cook County suburbs

context.text: Incumbent Mike Quigley (D) defeated Matthew Conroy, Ellen Corley, and Anthony Michael Tamez in the March 17, 2026 Democratic primary. Tom Hanson defeated Barry Wicker and Kimball Ladien in the Republican primary.

summary.text: Quigley has represented Illinois' 5th Congressional District since 2009. He previously served on the Cook County Board of Commissioners and serves on the House Appropriations and Permanent Select Intelligence Committees.

background.text: Earned a bachelor's degree in political science from Roosevelt University (1981), a master's degree in public policy from the University of Chicago (1985), and a law degree from Loyola University School of Law (1989).
Worked as a lawyer and law professor before serving as a Cook County Commissioner for District 10, 1998-2009.

record.text: Serves on the House Committee on Appropriations (Subcommittees on Legislative Branch and on National Security, Department of State, and Related Programs) in the 119th Congress.
Serves on the House Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence (Subcommittees on Defense Intelligence and Overhead Architecture, and Open Source Intelligence) in the 119th Congress.
Chaired the Appropriations Subcommittee on Financial Services and General Government in the 117th Congress (2021-2022).

summary.text: Hanson is a small business owner who won the Republican primary in this district.

background.text: Lives in Illinois; career experience includes owning a small business.
